question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
-- Final result with rounded values and tier labels
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) AS customer_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01'
      AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
tiled AS (
    SELECT cust_id,
           customer_profit,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY customer_profit) AS tier
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
    'Tier ' || tier AS tier_label,
    ROUND(MIN(customer_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit,
    ROUND(MAX(customer_profit), 2) AS highest_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM tiled
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier
